How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Start with a little water-based lube, turn Pebble on low, and place the opening slightly off-center instead of directly on your most sensitive spot. Adjust the angle until the suction seals comfortably, then slowly build through the 5 suction and 5 vibration settings. If it feels too intense, lift it off for a second and come back at a lower setting.
